name: ECE 3411
title: Microprocessor Applications Laboratory
description: Design of software and interface hardware to use a microcomputer as an on-line, real-time element in data acquisition, filtering and control systems. Use of clocks, DAC's, ADC's, speech synthesis modules, and movement generators. Design project. Written and oral presentations of laboratory results.
requirement_description: CSE 3100 or ECE 1401; open only to students in the School of Engineering.
